declencheursAide.fiche_creee: As soon as a lead lands in “new contact”. Stops if the lead moves on.
declencheursAide.stage_atteint: When the lead reaches the chosen stage, whatever route it took.
declencheursAide.rdv_planifie: Anchored to the appointment time. A negative delay sends before: −1 day is the evening before.
declencheursAide.devis_sans_reponse: The quote is out and the client has not moved since the silence threshold.
declencheursAide.pause_reprise: On the day a paused lead's follow-up date comes around.

declencheursAide.client_inactif: Nothing has moved on the lead since the silence threshold, and it is neither signed nor lost.

editeur.intro: Three questions: what sets it off, what it says, and when it goes quiet.

editeur.seuilAide: The sequence only arms if nothing has moved on the lead for this many days.
editeur.etapesAide: The delay counts from the trigger. Negative means before: −1 day reminds a client the evening before.
editeur.stopSiStage: Stop if the lead changes stage
